policyDescription.final: Only issue Q when ready, at least3 simulation seconds after last accepted Q, for a living legal elite or non-melee special reachable from the original clipped deployment region and within650 player distance. Each requested special ID at most once per run after real SCAN_COMPLETED. Prefer elite, then player distance, then stable ID. No eligible special: do not Q. After actual Q, withhold primary fire for3 simulation seconds; original movement/avoidance/aim otherwise unchanged.
policyDescription.revision: Initial preparation considered original Q frequency plus3s fire withholding. Root revised BEFORE ANY EXECUTION because ready-Q every3s could chain withholding. The revised once-per-special gate is used by both versions. The unexecuted plan is not a failed attempt.
policyDescription.outcomePolicy: Retain all real deaths, stalls, timeouts and measurement failures; no seed replacements, retries, forced damage or victory. Candidate need not be faster, win, focus every requested target, or have greater cell damage.
policyDescription.planner: Baseline beaconPosition copied byte-for-byte; identical pure measurement planner in both versions. Published per-version protocol config reads and external commanded-ID/lastQ state only. No candidate helper mutates baseline.
policyDescription.damage: Positive finite TARGET_HIT, cause=protocol, protocolId=IMMUNE_BEACON is the sole cell damage authority; bite logs only supply matching metadata. Baseline has requested aim recipients, never accepted focus commands.
